plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-notify

[中文](README.zh.md) | English

Session-state notifications for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH): a **WxPusher push** plus a **real browser notification** — with sound and `requireInteraction` — whenever a session stops, exits with an error, or asks you a question. Everything is configured from a native settings page (设置 → 通知 / Settings → Notifications).

- **Two independent channels, one payload.** The Host detects the transition once and delivers the same content to WxPusher and to every open browser page.
- **Real system notifications.** `new Notification(...)` with a PNG icon, an optional WebAudio chime, and `requireInteraction` so the banner stays until you dismiss it.
- **Native settings page.** A `settings.section` page built from the plugin's own Config schema; every field is `volatile`, so edits apply **live** — no restart, no plugin remount.
- **Write-only secret.** The WxPusher `appToken` is declared `role('secret')`: it is stored in the profile, never returned over the wire, and edited through a path-addressed write.
- **Zero runtime dependencies beyond the schema library.** One Host file, one Client file, no build step.

## What triggers a notification

| Event | Source | Detail shown |
|---|---|---|
| **Session stopped** | `api-session/status` → `running: false` | the folded session title |
| **Exited with an error** | `api-session/error`, `agent/error` | the error message |
| **Question asked** | `user-questions/request` (observed, then delegated) | the first question |
| **Approval needed** | `approval/request` (observed, then delegated) | the tool name |

Two filters keep the noise down:

- **`minRunMs`** — a run shorter than this never reports a stop.
- **`stopDebounceMs`** — after the agent goes idle the Host waits this long; if the session starts running again the report is dropped. A stop is also suppressed when an error notification for the same session just fired, because that one is more precise.

`user-questions/request` and `approval/request` are Cordis **waterfalls**: this plugin only observes them and always delegates with `next()`, so it can never swallow a request meant for another answerer.

## Requirements

- A DSH Host with the Web surface (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app`), i.e. any normal `dsh web` profile. `ctx.webServer` is used for the notification stream; without it the plugin still pushes to WxPusher but delivers nothing to the browser.
- Node.js ≥ 20.
- A browser that supports the Notification API (Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari 16+).
- A [WxPusher](https://wxpusher.zjiecode.com) account, only if you want phone pushes.

## Install

### Through the plugin manager (recommended)

Add the package spec to the Plugins page — a registry name, a git URL, or an absolute path to a checkout — and enable the bundle it adds:

```
dsh-plugin-notify
```

or, from a clone:

```
/path/to/dsh-plugin-notify
```

The plugin's row is declared by the bundle's own `cordis.patch.yml`, so nothing else needs editing. If the profile was already running, reload it (or restart) so the new package enters the module-resolution table.

### Manually, in a profile

```bash
# in the profile directory, e.g. ~/.dsh/profiles/web
pnpm add dsh-plugin-notify
```

Then add the bundle to `dsh.profile.bundles` in that profile's `package.json`:

```json
{
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-base", "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app", "dsh-plugin-notify"]
    }
  }
}
```

## Configure

Open **Settings → Notifications** (设置 → 通知). The page writes straight into the plugin's profile entry.

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | Master switch for both channels. |
| `events.stopped` | `true` | Report a session that stopped working. |
| `events.error` | `true` | Report a session or step that errored. |
| `events.question` | `true` | Report a question from the agent. |
| `events.approval` | `false` | Report a pending approval decision. |
| `browser.enabled` | `true` | Raise browser notifications at all. |
| `browser.sound` | `true` | Play a short two-tone chime (WebAudio, no asset). |
| `browser.requireInteraction` | `true` | Keep the banner until dismissed. |
| `browser.onlyWhenHidden` | `true` | Stay quiet while the tab is visible. |
| `wxpusher.enabled` | `false` | Enable the WxPusher channel. |
| `wxpusher.appToken` | `''` | WxPusher `appToken` (**write-only secret**). |
| `wxpusher.uids` | `[]` | Receiving UIDs, one per line (`UID_xxxxxxxx`). |
| `wxpusher.topicIds` | `[]` | Receiving topic ids, one per line. |
| `wxpusher.url` | `''` | Optional URL a tapped push opens. |
| `advanced.stopDebounceMs` | `1200` | Idle grace period before reporting a stop. |
| `advanced.minRunMs` | `2000` | Runs shorter than this never notify. |
| `advanced.rootSessionsOnly` | `true` | Skip subagent sessions. |
| `advanced.includeSessionTitle` | `true` | Include the folded session title. |
| `advanced.maxDetailChars` | `300` | Truncate error/question detail. |

The same values live in the profile patch, so they survive upgrades:

```yaml
- id: dsh-plugin-notify
  config:
    events:
      approval: true
    wxpusher:
      enabled: true
      uids:
        - UID_xxxxxxxx
```

### WxPusher credentials

1. Sign in at <https://wxpusher.zjiecode.com>, create an application, and copy its **appToken**.
2. Follow the app's QR code with WeChat to subscribe, then copy your **UID** from the app's user list (or use a **topic id** to reach many subscribers).
3. Paste the appToken and the UIDs into the settings page and press **Save**.

The appToken input is always empty on load — the Host only ever reports *whether* a token is set.

### Browser permission

The page shows the current `Notification.permission`. If it is `default`, press **Request permission**; if it is `denied`, re-allow notifications for the page in your browser's site settings. Sound needs one user gesture on the page before the browser lets an `AudioContext` start — the plugin hooks the first click/keypress to unlock it.

### Test

Each channel card owns its own test button, so a test never leaves you guessing which card it belongs to:

| Card | Button | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| **Browser notifications** | *Send a test notification* | Broadcasts a frame to every connected page **and** pushes one WxPusher message — a full-stack probe. |
| **WxPusher push** | *Send a test push* | Pushes one WxPusher message only. It raises no system notification, and it works while `wxpusher.enabled` is still off, so credentials can be verified before switching the channel on. |

Each button reports its own outcome underneath:

```
Browser: delivered to 1 page(s) · WxPusher: sent
WxPusher: no appToken
WxPusher: refused (appToken不正确)
Browser: no connected page (browser notifications may be off) · WxPusher: no UID or topic id
```

The buttons call the same endpoint with a `channel` selector — see below.

## How it works

```
Host                                    Browser
────                                    ───────
api-session/status ─┐
api-session/error  ─┤
agent/error        ─┼─► detect ─► frame ─┬─► WxPusher HTTPS push
user-questions/…   ─┤                    │
approval/request   ─┘                    └─► GET /dsh-plugin-notify/events (SSE)
                                                        │
                                                        ▼
                                            new Notification(title, {
                                              body, icon, tag,
                                              requireInteraction, silent,
                                            })  +  WebAudio chime
```

- The Host plugin registers two exact routes on `ctx.webServer`: the SSE stream at `/dsh-plugin-notify/events` and the test endpoint at `/dsh-plugin-notify/test`.
- The Client half opens an `EventSource` on the **document-relative** path `dsh-plugin-notify/events`, so it resolves under whatever mount served the page and inherits the page's own authentication. `EventSource` reconnects by itself; the Host sends a `: ping` heartbeat every 25 s.
- The settings page resolves its namespace from `

plugins.description: AI 也要下班。到点话越来越少，凌晨三点只剩一句「明天再说」；已下班照样收消息，只是只回一个「。」
plugins.readme_text:
# AI Curfew · AI 熄灯

[中文](README.md) | [English](README.en.md)

**把「AI 永远在线」拧成「AI 也要下班」。**

到点之后回复越来越短，深夜档把 `max_tokens` 从 2048 慢慢压到 64，凌晨三点只回一句「明天再说」。
高峰时段不上班、低谷时段上班；已下班状态照样收消息，但只回一个「。」。

> 卖点不是让模型**演**下班，而是**真的**下班：下班后一个 API 请求都不发 —— 0 token、0 成本、毫秒返回。

![node >=22](badges/node.svg)
![platform DeepSeek Harness](badges/platform.svg)
![dependencies none](badges/dependencies.svg)
![tests](https://github.com/qiz42144-web/dsh-ai-curfew/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)
![off-duty cost 0 tokens](badges/cost.svg)
![license MIT](badges/license.svg)

```
on-duty 上班中 ──→ winding 打烊倒计时 ──→ off-duty 已下班 ──→ lights-out 熄灯
   (满血)          maxTokens 2048→64        只回「。」        只回「明天再说。」
```

## 行为

| 时刻 | 判定 | 回法 |
|---|---|---|
| 周二 10:00 | 高峰 | `。` |
| 周二 20:00 | 低谷、未到宵禁 | 正常上班 |
| 周二 23:30 | 宵禁 winding | 短回复，预算 ≈1824 |
| 周三 01:30 | 宵禁 winding | 一句话，预算 ≈560 |
| 周三 02:30 | 宵禁 winding | 最多 20 字，预算 ≈192 |
| 周三 03:10 | 宵禁到底 | `明天再说。` |
| 周日 14:00 | 周末全天低谷 | 正常上班 |

两条独立的轴，**取谁更严谁生效**：

- **A 峰谷班表** —— 高峰不上班、低谷上班（周一至周五 9:00–12:00、14:00–18:00，扣掉周末与法定节假日）
- **B 宵禁曲线** —— 到点后预算沿锚点表从 2048 滑到 64，凌晨 3 点彻底熄灯

闸门 A 可以单独关掉，退化成纯宵禁插件。

## 安装

profile 是 DSH 里一套隔离的插件与配置环境，一台机器可以有好几套（常见的有 `desktop`、`web`、
`headless`）。把下面的 `desktop` 换成你实际在跑的那个。

**从 GitHub 装**（装了固定版本，推荐）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:qiz42144-web/dsh-ai-curfew#v0.1.0
```

末尾的 `#v0.1.0` 是 tag；去掉它就会跟着 `main` 的最新状态走。

**从本地目录装**（改这个插件本身时用）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:/绝对路径/ai-curfew
```

装好后客户端半体由 `/plugins` 提供（侧栏底部的状态胶囊 + Settings 里的班表页），Host 半体即刻生效。

## 配置

配置是 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-ai-curfew/config.json`，**改完即生效**（按 mtime 热读，不用重启）。
文件里只写你想改的键，其余走默认值：

```json
{
  "curfewStart": "23:00",
  "lightsOut": "03:00",
  "wakeUp": "09:00",
  "peakShift": true,
  "offDutyReply": "。",
  "lightsOutReply": "明天再说。",
  "debugNow": "01:30"
}
```

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | 总开关 |
| `timezone` | `Asia/Shanghai` | 班表按时区本地时间算 |
| `wakeUp` / `curfewStart` / `lightsOut` | `09:00` / `23:00` / `03:00` | 一天的四个相位，窗口可跨午夜 |
| `anchors` | 23:00→2048 … 03:00→64 | 预算锚点表，`[时刻, tokens]` |
| `curve` | `linear` | `linear`（锚点间插值） / `step`（阶梯） / `easeIn`（先稳后崩） |
| `peakShift` / `peakWindows` / `weekendValley` / `holidays` | 开 / 9-12,14-18 / 开 / 2026 表 | 峰谷闸门 |
| `offDutyReply` / `lightsOutReply` | `。` / `明天再说。` | 不请求时回什么 |
| `tiredPersona` / `tierTexts` | 开 / 四档 | 往提示词注入的疲惫档位，每四分之一窗口一档 |
| `denyToolsWhenOffDuty` | `true` | 下班后不再执行工具调用 |
| `windingReasoningEffort` | `null` | 可选：宵禁期间降到某个 reasoning effort id |
| `dryRun` | `false` | 只判定并记录，照常发请求（安全试跑） |
| `debugNow` | `null` | 时间机器：`HH:MM` 或 `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM` |
| `applyToSubagents` | `true` | 子代理是否一起宵禁；设 `false` 让派出去的活继续干完 |
| `exemptSessions` | `[]` | 豁免的会话 id，完全不干预 |
| `safetyMaxTokens` | `null` | 见下方说明，默认关闭 |

### 命令行

```
/curfew                    看班表：当前判定、预算与依据
/curfew overtime 30m       强制加班 30 分钟（宵禁暂停，期间正常上班）
/curfew off                立刻下班
/curfew auto               恢复自动班表（加班 / 强制下班 / 时间机器 全部取消）
/curfew debug 01:30        时间机器，随时试任何时段
/curfew debug clear        回到真实时间
```

命令不经过模型，所以下班状态下也能用 —— 这是「把自己关在门外」的逃生口。

**为什么是「加班」不是「请假」**：请假的主语是 AI，是它在请求不上班；但 `/curfew overtime`
实际发生的是**你命令它加班**。同理 `off` 只管「AI 下班」这一件事，不再兼职表示「宵禁关掉」。

### 关于 `safetyMaxTokens`

默认**关闭**，这是有意的。下班由 `llm/stream` 短路保证，所以第二道上限在它有用的地方都是多余的；
而在它不该管的地方反而有害 —— reasoning 模型会把很小的预算全花在思考上，于是既没有正文也没有
工具调用，供应商直接判这一轮失败：

```
Command Code reached the output token limit without producing answer text or a tool call
(finish_reason=length, max_tokens=16, outputTokens=16, reasoningTokens=16)  [OUTPUT_TOKEN_LIMIT]
```

想加一道硬上限可以自己填数字，但请按模型的**思考预算**来给，而不是按你期望的回复长度。

## 原理

下班回复走 `llm/stream` waterfall 的**短路**：直接吐一段合成的流，完全不触网。
这不是 `agent/pre-step` 的 `reject` —— 那样这一轮会彻底没有回复，用户看到的是「AI 死了」。
需求是「照样收消息，只回一个句号」，所以必须产出一条**真实的 assistant 消息**，由 agent loop 自己
组装并写入会话日志，我们只负责提供 chunk。

完整设计、踩过的坑、以及「为什么不能用 `agent/pre-step` + 手写事件」见
[`docs/architecture.md`](docs/architecture.md)；核实过的 DSH 契约见
[`docs/dsh-contracts.md`](docs/dsh-contracts.md)。

## 开发

```sh
node --test          # 零依赖；验收表就是断言
```

行为判定全是纯函数（`duty.js` / `clock.js`），所以整套班表不需要跑 Host 就能测。

徽章是**提交进仓库的本地 SVG**（`node scripts/make-badges.mjs` 重新生成），不走 shields.io ——
不依赖任何第三方服务，也不会因为图片代理不可达而裂图。只有 tests 那个是 GitHub 自己的工作流
徽章（同样在 github.com 上，不经第三方），因为它报的是**测试现在过不过**，比"用什么命令跑"有用。

CI 跑在 GitHub Actions 上：Node 22 / 24 × Linux / Windows 四个组合。因为零依赖，**没有 install
步骤**，就是 checkout + 一行 `node --test`。同一条流水线还会校验 `badges/` 与生成器一致 ——
手改徽章或改了生成器没重跑，都会红。

**改完代码要重启 DSH 才生效。** 运行中的进程按 URL 缓存插件的 ES module，停用再启用只会重跑
`apply()`，不会重新 import。`scripts/dev-reload.ps1` 用一个新 revision 目录 + 重接 junction 绕开它，
代价只要一次停用/启用。为什么 HMR 那条路走不通，也记在
[`docs/architecture.md`](docs/architecture.md#developing-against-a-running-host)。

## 状态

**尚未发布到 npm**，从 GitHub 装上就能用（见上面的安装一节）；版本 `0.1.0`。
哪些行为已经实测验收、哪些还没有，见 [`docs/acceptance.md`](docs/acceptance.md)。

## 许可与出处

MIT。峰谷口径与 2026 节假日数据的来源、署名，以及必须每年 11 月补表的维护责任，见
[`PROVENANCE.md`](PROVENANCE.md)。

plugins.description: Verified-progress ledger for long-running DSH work: an independent verifier certifies each claimed step, and a fingerprint check voids any verdict whose verifier mutated the workspace.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-verified-progress

**A verified-progress ledger for long-running DSH work — where a verdict only
counts if the thing that produced it provably stayed read-only.**

A long-running task fails in a specific way: the agent reports progress it cannot
prove, the report enters the transcript, and the next turn builds on a claim that
was never checked. Nothing downstream can tell a verified step from an optimistic
one, so the error compounds until the final answer is confidently wrong.

This plugin adds the missing check. When the agent claims a step is done, an
**independent verifier with a fresh context** inspects the real workspace and
returns a structured verdict. Only a clean, aligned, complete verdict enters the
ledger. A rejected step stays in the ledger as *evidence* — it is never promoted
to progress.

```
claim ──▶ independent verification ──▶ verdict
                                        │
                        complete + clean + aligned ──▶ ledger (progress)
                                        │
                                    anything else ──▶ ledger (evidence only)
```

## The part that is not a prompt

Read-only verifiers are usually enforced by asking the verifier to behave and by
removing the write tools from its tool set. Both are prevention, and both are
defeated by anything the tool filter does not name.

This plugin **detects** instead. The workspace is fingerprinted — every file's
size and mtime, plus a SHA-256 for files under the hash limit — immediately
before and after each verification episode. If anything changed, the verifier
mutated the workspace during a read-only audit, so its own findings are voided by
construction: the round is recorded as `blocked` / `violation` and **can never be
promoted to progress**, no matter how clean its report reads.

That matters because a verifier that writes is not a neutral witness. It can
create the evidence it then reports, and no amount of prompt discipline or tool
allow-listing proves it did not. A fingerprint comparison does not have to trust
the verifier at all — which is why the ledger's admission rule can be absolute:

```
integrity === "violation" || contract !== "aligned"  ⟹  status !== "complete"
```

This is enforced in code, not requested in a prompt. A verifier that omits a
control line degrades conservatively — an unstated integrity is read as
`suspect`, never as `clean` — because a placeholder must never be the thing that
certifies work as done.

## What it does

**1. Independent verification instead of self-report.** The verifier is a
separate subagent that inherits no conversation context. It reads the files and
answers with three control lines:

```
Status: complete | incomplete | blocked
Integrity: clean | suspect | violation
Contract audit: aligned | unknown | needs_revision | invalid
```

**2. A durable verified-progress ledger.** Accepted steps are appended to
`ledger.jsonl` (one JSON object per line, fsync'd per append) with a last-wins
projection in `state.json`. A crashed process, a compacted context, or a fresh
session can reopen the run and answer: what is verified, what was rejected and
why, and what is left. Rejected rounds are preserved as evidence rather than
discarded, so a later turn can see which claims were already tried and failed.

**3. Mutation detection.** Described above; it is the admission rule for the
ledger, not a side feature.

## Tools

| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `verified_progress_verify` | Verify one claimed step against the workspace; records the verdict in the ledger. |
| `verified_progress_ledger` | Read back verified progress, rejected claims, and what remains. |
| `verified_progress_state` | Current run state: verified rounds, pending claims, open items. |

### Declaring what the guard may judge

`verified_progress_verify` takes a `guard_scope`: a workspace-relative path or
glob whose non-glob prefix becomes the fingerprint root.

```
verified_progress_verify  claim="the parser handles CRLF input"
                          guard_scope="src/parser/**"
```

This is not optional decoration. The guard originally fingerprinted the whole
workspace root, and in the desktop profile that root is the harness home itself —
`sessions/**`, `storages/**` and plugin state are written continuously by the
very session the plugin runs inside. The first two verifications came back
`workspace mutated (+3 ~5 -3)`, and every changed path belonged to the harness.
The verifier had written nothing. **A guard that accuses the verifier of the
host's writes fails every round while looking like a conservative verdict**, so
the scope is now declared rather than assumed:

- the scope must resolve **inside** the workspace; absolute paths and `..` are
  rejected instead of silently widened;
- when the workspace is the harness home, a scope is **required**, and
  harness-owned roots (`sessions`, `storages`, `logs`, `telemetry`, `cache`,
  `profiles`, …) are excluded **only at the root**, so a real project containing
  a nested `sessions/` is still guarded;
- the result prints `Fingerprinted: <path>`, so a verdict never leaves its scope
  ambiguous.

## Install

Pick the line that matches the machine.

**A released tarball — no registry, no git.** This is the one that works
everywhere:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add \
  https://github.com/lion231226/dsh-verified-progress/releases/latest/download/dsh-verified-progress.tgz
```

**From the registry**, once the package is published there:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-verified-progress
```

**From the repository** — only if `git` is installed:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:lion231226/dsh-verified-progress
```

> **A repository address needs `git` on the machine, and the failure is not
> obvious.** pnpm resolves a git dependency with `git ls-remote`, so on a host
> without git the install dies with
> `Command failed with exit code 1: git ls-remote "…" HEAD "HEAD^{}"` followed by
> the shell's own "not recognized as an internal or external command" message in
> the local codepage — which reads like a broken plugin rather than a missing
> tool. The tarball form above downloads over HTTPS and needs nothing installed,
> so it is the safe default. (Installing git also fixes it; nothing about the
> plugin is at fault.)

Then restart the harness: a plugin that failed to activate is not retried, and
the module cache holds the previous version until the process restarts. No build
step — the package ships plain ESM and has no runtime dependencies.

## Storage

Everything lives under the harness state directory, not in your project:

```
<state>/verified-progress/runs/<runId>/ledger.jsonl
<state>/verified-progress/runs/<runId>/state.json
```

`<runId>` is derived from the session id when there is one, otherwise from a hash
of the working directory, so reopening the same session reopens the same run.

## Design limits — read these

- **The verifier is a separate agent, not a separate process.** It cannot see the
  executor's conversation, which is what makes it independent, and it runs with a
  read-only tool set. It runs inside the harness and is subject to the same
  permissions; the fingerprint check is what makes a violation detectable rather
  than impossible.
- **The mutation guard is a correctness tool, not a security boundary.** It
  compares file fingerprints. It does not defend against a local attacker, it is
  not a sandbox, and it does not cover paths excluded from the snapshot.
- **Unhashed large files are reported as an evidence gap.** Files above the hash
  limit are compared by size and mtime, and the snapshot says so rather than
  claiming a comparison it did not make.
- **Verification costs tokens.** Each verified step adds one verifier episode.
  The ledger is what you get for it; if your task is a single short turn, you do
  not need this plugin.

## Why this exists

The loop design is ported from [LongHorizon-Harness](https://github.com/AMAP-ML/LongHorizon-Harness)
(AMAP-ML, MIT) — manager/executor/auditor rounds, a durable round ledger, and an
auditor that cannot certify a dirty result.

That project is a Python orchestrator that wraps an agent CLI. It does no

plugins.description: Account balance and per-session cost pill for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web GUI: official peak/off-peak pricing, per-model breakdown, no credentials stored.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-cost

**Account balance and cost statistics** pill for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). It adds a pill at the right-hand end of the official stats row below the session composer, combining three readings: the billing period (peak / off-peak, colour-coded), the account balance, and the current session cost. Clicking the pill expands a per-session breakdown — cache-hit input, cache-miss input and output amounts, plus cost per model. The cost side needs no credentials; the balance side needs a DeepSeek API key.

> Community plugin. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or shipped by DeepSeek.

## Screenshots

![Cost pill at the right-hand end of the stats row](assets/screenshots/pill-101c.png)

![Breakdown popup](assets/screenshots/dialog-101c.png)

## Features

- **Rightmost pill in the stats row**: registers into `conversation.composer.dock` with `order: 2`, after both official stats pills (`activity` = 0, `usage` = 1). The period reads `Peak` or `Off-peak`, and a red / green dot distinguishes them.
- **Popup breakdown**: billing period, account balance, current session cost, and the cost split by bucket — cache-hit input, cache-miss input (cache writes included), output — plus a per-model breakdown whenever the host can fold one.
- **Official pricing**: the 2026-09-10 price cut and the pro→flash routing are both modelled. While the session is attached, usage is folded per request, so a session spanning a price change, a routing change or a peak boundary never mixes two rate tables.
- **Peak / off-peak clock**: workday windows `09:00–12:00` and `14:00–18:00`; everything else, weekends and statutory holidays bill off-peak all day (including a weekend that holiday adjustment turns into a workday). The built-in 2026 PRC holiday table can be replaced through `Config.holidays`.
- **Rates follow official pricing**: the rate table ships inside the plugin and is refreshed with plugin releases.
- **Works without an API key**: installs signed in with a DeepSeek account still see the billing period and the session cost; only the balance is absent.
- **No credentials stored**: the key is resolved through dsh's credentials seam, used in-process, and never written to disk.
- **Bilingual**: 14 dictionary entries under the `cost-stats` namespace, Chinese and English, following the app locale.
- **Host route only**: the browser half reads the host route `/api/dsh-balance` (once per session step plus a 60 s poll) and never contacts a third party.
- **No local state**: nothing is persisted; uninstalling leaves no data behind.
- **Native behaviour**: positioning and outside-dismiss reuse the official `ui-primitives` helpers (`useAnchoredPosition`, `useDismissOnOutsidePointer`).

## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness (dsh) `>= 0.2.1-rc.2`.
- A DeepSeek **API key** if you want the balance. It is resolved through dsh's credentials seam; the plugin falls back to the `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` environment variable **only when the credentials service itself is unavailable** — if credentials exists but holds no such key, the environment variable is not consulted. When no key resolves (for example an install signed in with a DeepSeek *account*), the pill keeps showing the billing period and the session cost, and only the balance is absent.

## Install

From the plugin market (search `dsh-cost`), or from a terminal:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-cost-pill
```

You can also install from the GitHub source: `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:Arun1016/dsh-cost`.

> Note: the bare npm name `dsh-cost` belongs to an unrelated project; this plugin is published under the `@arun_1016/` scope, so the two cannot be confused.

## Configuration

```yaml
- id: cost-stats
  name: dsh-cost
  config:
    holidays: ['2026-01-01']   # statutory holidays bill off-peak all day
```

`holidays` is the only Config field. It defaults to the built-in 2026 PRC statutory-holiday table (State Council notice 国办发明电〔2025〕7号), as Beijing-local `YYYY-MM-DD` dates. A new year is a Config edit, not a code change.

## Billing model

Prices are CNY per million tokens, and every figure below is a **peak** rate — off-peak is exactly half, per the official rule.

| Item | Rule |
|---|---|
| Flash (from 2026-09-10 12:00 Beijing) | peak `2 / 0.04 / 8` = uncached input / cache-hit input / output |
| Flash (before the price cut) | `3.0 / 0.1 / 9.0`, same three buckets |
| Pro (`deepseek-v4-pro`, before 2026-09-14 12:00 Beijing) | `9.0 / 0.3 / 27.0`, same three buckets |
| Peak window | workdays `09:00–12:00` and `14:00–18:00` |
| Off-peak | everything else; weekends and statutory holidays all day, including a weekend that holiday adjustment turns into a workday |
| Clock used | the local clock of the machine running dsh — the official windows are Beijing time, so the reading is only exact on a Beijing-time host |
| pro→flash routing | billed as Flash from 2026-09-14 12:00 Beijing |
| `inputTokens` | uncached input; cache writes bill at the uncached rate |
| reasoning | subset of output, not billed separately |

## Privacy

- No telemetry, no analytics, no third-party endpoints.
- The only outbound request is `https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance`, authenticated with your key; it times out after 15 s.
- The browser half only reads the host route `/api/dsh-balance` — once per session step, plus a 60 s poll. It never contacts a third-party endpoint itself.
- This plugin never writes the key to disk, and balances are cached in memory only.

## Known limitations

- While the session is attached the host folds usage per request, so a span across the price cut, the routing change or a peak boundary keeps its own rate table. A **detached** session is priced by the host as one aggregate at the current Flash rates and carries **no** estimate marker; the browser half's own fallback estimate uses the same current rates and is marked `(估)` in Chinese / `(est)` in English.
- Every reading is conditional: a missing balance hides only that segment; a cost of exactly `¥0.00` hides the cost segment; and when the host route is missing or errors, the whole pill disappears silently, with no placeholder and no error message. After a failure it stops per-step polling and keeps only the 60 s poll.
- Amounts always print with a `¥` prefix, regardless of the account currency the API reports. Balance uses 2 decimals; costs use 2 decimals, or 4 below `¥0.01`.
- The per-model breakdown appears only when the host can fold the session by model, and model ids are normalised (for example `deepseek-v4-flash` and `deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp` both display as `deepseek-flash`).
- Balance failures are silent: no key, an invalid key, a network error and the 15 s timeout all produce a `200` response with no `balance_infos` field, and that empty result is cached for 30 s as well.
- The balance cache is process-wide and shared across sessions; it is only invalidated by a different key, so a top-up can take up to 30 s to appear.
- Model ids the plugin does not recognise are priced with the Flash table.
- Costs accumulate per request, so rounding may differ from the account ledger.
- Events without a model source or usage are skipped.
- The popup has no height cap and does not share the official pills' mutual-exclusion state, so it can stay open alongside another popup.
- The built-in holiday table covers 2026 only.

## Development

Source lives in `src/` (host half `index.ts`, client half `client/`). It is built with the official dsh monorepo toolchain: `tsconfig.*.json` and `tsdown.config.ts` reference the monorepo through relative paths (`../../../tsconfig.base.json`, `../../client/tsdown.client.ts`), so building requires placing this package back into that tree — the repository cannot be built standalone.

The published package carries `lib/` and `cordis.patch.yml`, plus `package.json`, both READMEs and `LICENSE` (npm always includes those).

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

plugins.description: 给 DSH 的模型一只可调精度的时钟，外加会话内计时器。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-time-reminder

（已被插件市场收录！！）
[![Awesome DSH Plugin](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/badge.svg)](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com)

给 DSH 的模型一只**可调精度**的时钟，外加**会话内计时器**。

## 解决什么

模型默认不知道"现在几点"，也不知道"距上一轮结束过了多久"。长时间干活时这让它无法判断
"这次等了 20 秒"还是"等了 20 分钟"。官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-time-context` 能做基础注入，但
**不提供工具**、且刷新间隔在加载时被闭包固定，会话中改不了。本插件把控制权交给模型和你。

## 四种时间模式（每会话独立，随会话日志持久化）

| 模式 | 行为 | 用途 |
|---|---|---|
| `cron`（默认） | 跨过 cron 触发时刻注入一次；默认 `0 0 * * *`（每天 00:00，按你的浏览器时区） | 日常：知道今天几号、大概几点 |
| `off` | **不自动注入**；工具照常可查时间与计时器 | 上下文要干净时 |
| `turn` | **每轮恰好一次**，在该轮第一步（即你发消息之后那一步）；给出距上一条模型可见消息的间隔 | 想每轮都知道"距上轮结束多久"，又不想每步都注入 |
| `fine` | **每个步骤都注入**（含每次工具调用之后） | 精确计时、要步间耗时 |

粒度谱：`off` < `cron`（按时间）< `turn`（每轮 1 条）< `fine`（每步约 19 条，实测均值）。

## 工具

```
time_mode       mode: off | cron | turn | fine   可选 cron: "<表达式>"
                切换精度；cron 表达式按会话时区解释

time_counter    action: start | lapse | list | note | scope | reset | remove
                name, note, inject, toChildren, toParents, depth
                建/查/改计时器；可见性属性在调用时设置

time_countdown  action: start | snooze | cancel | list
                name, in（"10m"/"1h30m"/"90s"）, at（"15:30"）, onFire, note
                一次性倒计时：到点把自己叫醒（或只投一条通知）
```

`time_counter` 的属性：

| 属性 | 默认 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `inject` | `false` | 是否加入每次自动读数 |
| `toChildren` | `true` | 是否让**子代理**读到 |
| `toParents` | `false` | 是否让**父代理**读到 |
| `depth` | `2` | 可见性沿谱系穿透**几代**（1 = 直接父子，2 = 也含祖孙） |

计数器只存在于自己会话的状态里（随会话日志持久化），不跨会话共享。
`cron` 表达式同样是**每会话状态**：用 `time_mode` 改过之后，恢复会话仍然沿用。

### 倒计时（`time_countdown`）

一次性定时器，`in` 给相对时长（`90s` / `10m` / `1h30m` / `2d`），`at` 给**会话时区**里的钟点
（`15:30`，今天已过就顺延到明天）；两者**必须给且只给一个**。`snooze` 用 `in` 把它往后挪
（会清掉"已触发"标记，重新变回待触发），`cancel` 删掉。

**已触发的不是"删掉"而是"收起来"**：`list` 默认只列**待触发**的（触发记录留着，
`includeFired: true` 才显示，最近 10 条、新的在前）。这样 `list` 始终是"还欠什么"的视图，
而不会随响过的提醒越积越长；同时"**顺延刚响过的那条**"（`snooze` 会清 `firedAt` 重新武装）
和"我刚才那条到底响了没"仍然可查 —— 记录一旦真删，这两种用法就都没了。

到点做什么由 `onFire` 决定：

| `onFire` | 默认 | 行为 |
|---|---|---|
| `wake` | ✅ | 投一条通知**并唤醒**该会话（空闲的会话会被拉起来开一轮）——这样"到点执行动作"才真的发生 |
| `inject` | | 只把通知排进该会话的下一步，**不唤醒**（省 token，但空闲会话可能很久之后才看到） |

**持久化与重启**：倒计时折进同一份会话状态（`stateVersion: 3`），**会话日志仍是唯一真值**；
另有一份**待办索引表**（`<DSH_HOME>/time-reminder/countdowns.json`，可用 `pendingTable` / `pendingPath` 配置）
只回答一个问题——"哪些会话还欠一条倒计时"。它存在的理由：插件**看不见没被恢复的会话**
（`sessions.list()` 只列活会话、`get()` 不恢复、没有枚举已存会话的 API），
宿主重启后若没人打开那个会话，光靠折叠根本不知道有这么条倒计时在等。

于是重启后的路径是：**读表 → 对每个待办会话 `resolveAgent`（resolve-or-resume）→ 折叠日志判断是否还欠 →
该武装的武装、该丢的行丢掉**。表里的行**不是真值**：倒计时被取消、已触发、或时间被改过，都会在对账时
按折叠结果修正，所以一行陈旧数据不可能凭空造出提醒。宿主当时没运行的倒计时会在启动后**立刻补发**
（通知里注明迟了多久）；失败方向是**至少一次**：极窄的窗口里可能重复提醒一次，但不会静默丢掉。

**它不会带偏读数节奏**：触发通知来源带 `countdown` 标记且 `form: 'notice'`，折叠把它当作
"这个倒计时已触发"的凭据，而**不**当作读数——所以触发不会重置 `cron` / `turn` 的节奏。
待触发的倒计时会出现在读数里（见下），让模型知道自己排了什么。

**通知会说明"为什么不是准点到的"**，而且原因是**触发那一刻观察到的**，不是猜的：

| 观察到的情况 | 通知里补的那句 |
|---|---|
| 定时器在触发点**之后**才被武装（装载/扫描补发） | `It came due before this session's countdown timers were running again, so this is the first chance to deliver it (12m0s late).` |
| 回调本身迟了 ≥2 秒 | `The timer went off 7s late, so the process was suspended or blocked at that instant.` |
| 触发时 `agent.status === 'running'`（会话正卡在某一步里） | `This session was in the middle of a step, so the notice waited for that step to end.` |
| 都不成立（准点 + 会话空闲） | 什么都不加——没有延迟需要解释 |

后两条可以同时成立，那时两句都会出现；**2 秒以内的抖动不算迟到**（否则会写成误导性的 `0s late`，
并把原因错记到宿主头上——实测两次的真相都是"定时器准点，只是我当时卡在工具调用里"）。

**冷会话会被自动恢复**：触发时若会话不在驻留中（`ctx.agents` 里没有 Agent），插件走宿主会话控制器的
`resolveAgent` —— 文档原话是"**Resolve or resume** one ordinary Session for another Host API domain"
（`api/session-controller/src/index.ts`），官方 `dsh-schedule` 投递时用的同一个办法（`schedule/src/runtime.ts:101`）。
这是可选服务（web profile 才有），所以用 `ctx.get('sessionController')` 读。

⚠️ 实测到的细节：**这个服务可能比本插件挂得更晚**——冷启动时插件加载那一刻它还是 `undefined`
（调试日志里的 `reconcile.row … verdict:"no-controller"`），20 秒后会话才由**客户端重连**恢复
（`deliver.done … resumedHere:false`）。所以除启动对账外还注册了
`ctx.inject(['sessionController'], …)`：**服务一出现就再对账一次**——那才是"恢复成为可能"的时刻。
没有这个控制器的组合（headless / 纯 SDK）里，表仍能"找到"会话，但无法把它恢复成活会话，
倒计时只能等会话自己回来（见下面的已知限制）。

### 计数器变动会推送给"看得见它"的会话

`start`（含重启）/ `reset` / `note` / `scope` / `remove` 都会给相关会话送一条
`<system-reminder>` 通知（`lapse` / `list` 这类只读动作不送）。收件人是**变更前后可见集合的并集**——
所以把 `scope` 收窄、或直接 `remove` 时，原来看得见的那些会话也会收到"它走了"。
通知的来源是 `form: 'relay'` + `senderSessionId`，**不会被当成时间读数**（否则会把对方的 cron/turn 节奏带偏）。

投递方式由配置决定（见下）：`inject`（默认，投到对方下一个步骤、**不唤醒**）、
`steer`（投到最近一步并唤醒 idle 的对方）、`off`（不送）。对方会话不在驻留中（例如已收工的子代理）时投不进去，
但它的状态本来就从日志折叠，等它下次醒来照样能看到。

## 注入读数长这样

读数以 `<system-reminder>` 块注入（与 AGENTS.md 同一套框法，模型按"系统上下文"读，而不是"用户说的话"）：

```
<system-reminder>
Time sampled while preparing turn 12, step 1: 2026-10-09T01:23:45+08:00[Asia/Shanghai]
Time mode: cron (daily 00:00 Asia/Shanghai; previous reading 2026-10-08T00:00:03+08:00[Asia/Shanghai])
Elapsed since the preceding model-visible message: 3m7s
[counters] deploy=20m43s (开始部署)
[countdowns] build in 4m12s (看 GH Actions)
</system-reminder>
```

第一行是时刻；第二行说明当前精度与"上次读数"（可追溯）；第三行是距上一条模型可见消息的间隔
（第 1 步）或距上一条读数的间隔（后续步）。第四行只在有计数器开了 `inject` 时出现；
第五行只在有**待触发倒计时**时出现（最近的优先，最多列 5 条）。

**用户也看得见**：来源声明为 `form: 'notice'` 并带一行摘要（如 `turn reading · 2026-10-09T01:23:45+08:00`），
GUI 里那条折叠的"上下文注入"行**不展开就能读到"什么读数、什么时候"**，展开是完整读数。
（官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-time-context` 用 `form: 'snapshot'`，它不记录摘要，折叠行只剩生产者名——读数在，但一眼看不见。）

## 顶栏小钟

浏览器半边：**会话头部工具区**一枚小钟图标（挂在 `conversation.session.header.utilities` 槽位，
`order: 118`，即 SSH 胶囊右侧），**鼠标悬停**展开卡片。卡片是**一排三块**，并**锚定小钟右缘、向左生长**
（小钟在头部靠右，向右长会顶出视口）：

```
[计时器][倒计时][时钟 + 模式]
```

**左块 · 计时器**：本会话的计数器，每格是名字 + 已过时长（每秒走动）。3×3 网格、**每页 9 个**，右上角翻页。
**故意只读**：不给暂停/修改，免得模型对"基线悄悄变了"感到困惑（这是设计决定，不是没做完）。右键格子可删除，
块头 `＋新建` 可建（默认 `inject: true`，即跟读数一起进模型上下文）。

**右块 · 倒计时**：本会话待触发的倒计时，每格是一个 **SVG 圆环**——弧长 = `已过 / (触发点 - 设定点)`，
**环内是剩余时间**（`12m` / `3m20s`），快到时变警示色；环下是名字，`·静` 表示这个倒计时 `onFire: inject`。
同样每页 9 个、右键删除、`＋新建`（名字 + 时长，如 `15m`）。

**最右 · 时钟 + 模式**：

- **当前时间**（每秒走动）、日期星期、浏览器时区；
- **本会话的时间提醒推送模式**：四个按钮（关闭 / 定时 / 每轮 / 每步），当前模式高亮，下面一行说明它的效果；
  选到 `定时` 时多一个**计划表达式输入框**（回车或点"保存"提交，非法表达式由宿主回 `400 bad-cron` 并显示原因）；
  改完显示"已请求，将在下一步生效"。

这三块里的每一项都是**每会话**的，所以卡片读写都带 `sessionId`（由会话作用域的槽位从框架那里拿到）。宿主侧路由：

| 路由 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `GET /time-reminder/api/state?sessionId=…` | 返回 `{ mode, cron, pending, live, timeZone, effect, counters[], countdowns[] }`（计时器带 `startedAt`/`elapsedMs`/`inject`，倒计时带 `firesAt`/`setAt`/`remainingMs`/`onFire`，卡片据此本地走时与画环） |
| `POST /time-reminder/api/mode`（body `{ sessionId, mode, cron? }`） | 改模式，可选**同时改计划**（参数形状与 `time_mode` 工具一致）；会话不在驻留中回 `409 not-live`（先把会话打开再点），表达式非法回 `400 bad-cron` |
| `POST /time-reminder/api/counter`（body `{ sessionId, action, name, note?, inject? }`） | `action` 为 **`start` / `remove`**——就是 `time_counter` 工具自己的动作词 ✔ |
| `POST /time-reminder/api/countdown`（body `{ sessionId, action, name, in?, at?, onFire?, note? }`） | `action` 为 **`start` / `cancel`**——同样是 `time_countdown` 的动作词 ✔ |

路由全部**只接受回环地址**（`Host` 为 `127.0.0.1` / `localhost` / `[::1]`，否则 `403`）：web 服务可能绑在
局域网上，不能让别的设备翻你的模式、删你的计时器。

**改动怎么落到状态里**：不是另存一份设置，而是**写回会话日志**——宿主发一条本插件来源的消息，带上折叠认识的
字段（模式的 `mode`/`cron`、计数器的 `counterSpec`、倒计时的 `countdownSpec`），折叠把它们交给**工具用的同一批
纯函数**（`timeModeChange` / `counterChange` / `countdownChange`）处理 ✔。于是：重放日志得到同一个状态、没有第二份
真值会漂移、**卡片也不可能提交工具会拒绝的东西**（校验只有一处）。实测抓到过：我一度以为计数器的删除动作叫
`delete`，而工具的词表是 `remove` ✗ —— 共用校验让这种错只会表现为"什么都没发生"，不会写坏状态 ✔。

这些消息**都不算读数**（各自的字段分支排在"读数"分支之前，值坏了也一样），否则改一下设置就把你要的那次读数吃掉了。

**立即反馈**：`agent.inject` 是排队投递的（消息在下一个步边界才折进状态），所以卡片在日志追上来之前用一份
2 分钟的内存"最近请求"覆盖显示——日志一旦一致就撤掉，它不参与任何持久状态。

产物是手写的 `client/index.js`（**不参与 TypeScript 构建**——`scripts/build.mjs` 只处理 `src/`），
由 `package.json` 的 `dsh.client` 清单加载：`platform: web` + `inject` 列出所需的客户端包
（`dsh-client-ui-slots` 提供槽位服务、`dsh-client-ui-conversation` 定义那个槽位），入口走
`exports["./client"]`。**不需要在 `cordis.patch.yml` 里加行**——宿主行照旧，客户端半边靠清单发现
（与已发布的 `dsh-ssh-remote` 同一套形态）。宿主侧路由走 `ctx.inject(['webServer'], …)`
（可选服务：headless 组合里没有它，插件照样加载 ✔）。

正文里若出现 `</system-reminder>`（计数器备注是自由文本，可能带）会被转义成 `<\/system-reminder>`，防止提前闭合。

## 挂载

```yaml
- id: time-context          # 官方那行必须禁用，否则每步会有两条读数
  disabled: true
- insert:
    - id: time-reminder
      name: 'dsh-time-reminder'
      config:
        defaultMode: cron          # off | cron | turn | fine
        cron: '0 0 * * *'

plugins.description: Vision-first desktop computer use for DSH on macOS: OCR text targeting, set-of-mark indices, 11 desktop_* tools and a visible cursor. No accessibility tree. · 让 DSH 看着屏幕操作你的 Mac。
plugins.readme_text: **给 DSH 的 Mac 桌面操作能力（computer use）。视觉优先，不依赖无障碍权限。** > 以前叫 `dsh-cu`，2026-10-18 改名。旧地址会自动跳到这里；底层的命令行引擎仍叫 `dsh-cu`。 > 和别人家的 [dsh-computer-use](https://github.com/988hj7tczd-oss/dsh-computer-use) 不是一个东西：那个靠无障碍树（cua-driver），这个靠截图。 ![光标动效](assets/cursor-demo.gif) *桌面光标：实心蓝箭头 + 带显示器图标的「DSH」名牌，干活时名牌写上正在做什么。跟 [dsh-chrome-bridge](https://github.com/OrderG-X/dsh-chrome-bridge) 的浏览器光标是同一套样式，那边是半透明的、名牌带地球图标。* 11 个 `desktop_*` 工具 + 一个自包含的 Swift 命令行 + 一个看得见的桌面光标。 ``` desktop_windows desktop_observe desktop_screenshot desktop_find_text desktop_click desktop_type desktop_key desktop_apps desktop_launch desktop_scroll desktop_drag ``` --- ## 为什么又造一个 DSH 上已有的 computer use 插件（`dsh-computer-use`、`dsh-mac-cua` 等）大多依赖 **macOS 无障碍树（AX）**。 我们实测过：**锁屏时 AX 对所有应用都返回 0 个 AXWindow**，解锁后立刻恢复正常 —— 这是 macOS 的行为， 不是驱动的 bug（[详细记录](docs/locked-session-and-ax.md)）。另外第三方二进制在某些环境下拿不到 AXWindow。 **Codex 那种 computer use 走的是视觉路线**：截图 → 模型看 → 按坐标操作。这条路不碰 AX， 所以在 AX 不灵的环境下照样能用。这个仓库就是那条路，外加： | | | |---|---| | **OCR 找文字** | 用 macOS 自带的 Vision 框架，本地跑。`desktop_click(text="登录")` 直接按文字点 | | **元素编号** | `desktop_observe` 把可点元素在截图上编号，模型说"点第 7 个"就行 | | **看得见的光标** | 屏幕上有个蓝色光标跟着操作走，名牌写着「点击 发送」这类动作；跟浏览器插件的光标一套样式 | | **空闲自退** | 光标浮层 60 秒没动静自己走，不留常驻进程 | | **单文件 Swift** | 零依赖，好审计 | --- ## 安装 ```bash git clone https://github.com/OrderG-X/dsh-mac-computer-use.git cd dsh-mac-computer-use ./install.sh ``` 需要 macOS + Xcode Command Line Tools（`xcode-select --install`）。光标是代码画的，不用另装素材。 装完去 DSH 的**插件页**，把这个仓库地址加进去，然后**重启 DSH**。 装好后插件页里叫「**Mac 桌面操作**」。点进去是设置页：能不能用、看得到几个窗口，命令行引擎、屏幕录制权限、辅助功能权限、光标浮层逐项打勾，缺哪个就给哪个的按钮（复制安装命令 / 打开系统设置）；还有「屏幕上显示操作光标」开关。 --- ## 用起来是什么样 ``` 你：帮我看看屏幕上有什么 → desktop_windows 拿到窗口列表和坐标 → desktop_screenshot 模型看到图 你：点那个「登录」按钮 → desktop_click(text="登录") OCR 找到它 → 发事件过去（不动你的鼠标） 你：把计算器的 7+8 算一下 → desktop_observe 截图 + 元素编号 → desktop_click(index=5) 点第 5 个（"7"） → desktop_screenshot 再截一次确认 ``` **推荐工作流是 `observe → click(index)`** —— 模型看图上的编号，比算坐标可靠得多。 --- ## 底层 ``` DSH 工具 (desktop_*) ↓ spawn dsh-cu (Swift 单文件) ├── winlist CGWindowListCopyWindowInfo ← 窗口坐标，零权限 ├── observe AX 枚举可点元素 + 截图标注编号 ├── shot screencapture ├── find Vision 框架 OCR ← 找文字 → 可点坐标 ├── clickat CGEvent postToPid ← 不移动真实鼠标、不抢前台 ├── type/key CGEvent ← 支持中文 ├── scroll/drag CGEvent └── launch NSWorkspace（后台启动，不抢前台） ``` 命令行也能单独用： ```bash dsh-cu winlist # 列窗口 dsh-cu tree # AX 树（解锁状态下可用） dsh-cu observe # 截图 + 编号 dsh-cu find "登录" # OCR 找文字 → 坐标 dsh-cu clickat # 点（默认不动真实鼠标） dsh-cu type "你好" # 输入 dsh-cu selftest # 全链路自检（见 tools/selftest.sh） ``` --- ## 光标 `cursor/cursor-overlay.swift` 是桌面光标浮层（装到 `~/.dsh/bin/dsh-cursor-overlay`）：NSPanel，不抢前台、点击穿透、永远置顶，闲 60 秒自己退出。 跟 [dsh-chrome-bridge](https://github.com/OrderG-X/dsh-chrome-bridge) 的浏览器光标是**一套样式**，一眼分得清是在哪边干活： | | 桌面（这个仓库） | 浏览器（dsh-chrome-bridge） | |---|---|---| | 箭头 | 同一个形状，实心蓝 | 同一个形状，半透明淡蓝 | | 名牌 | 显示器图标 + DSH | 地球图标 + DSH | | 干活时 | 名牌展开成「DSH · 点击 发送」 | 名牌展开成「DSH · 点击 登录」 | **动效**走克制路线，两边一样： - 同一个弹簧、同一套算法：沿轻微的弧线滑过去，顺着速度方向轻轻拉长（最多 7%）、略侧倾，名牌晚半拍跟上；到了冲过头最多两三像素再落回 - 点击时以箭头尖端为支点缩一下再弹回（瞄准点纹丝不动），一圈淡波纹 - 拖拽时按住（缩一点 + 尖端一圈光晕）跟着走；滚动时右上角亮一下方向 - 闲 6 秒变淡、名牌收起，不挡视线；系统开了「减少动态效果」就不做动画 浮层指令（往 `/tmp/dsh-cursor.fifo` 写一行）：`show x y` / `move x y` / `click [n]` / `down` / `up` / `scroll ±1` / `label 文字` / `hide` / `ping`。 --- ## 已知限制 - **锁屏时**：截图只有壁纸、窗口不渲染、AX 读不到窗口 —— 这是 macOS 的行为，不是工具的问题 - `desktop_click` 默认投递给目标进程（`postToPid`）。个别应用不响应投递事件，加 `global: true` 走系统事件兜底（会移动真实鼠标） - **桌面点击驱动不了 Chrome** —— Chrome 不理会投递的合成事件。操作浏览器请用 CDP 类工具（比如 [dsh-chrome-bridge](https://github.com/OrderG-X/dsh-chrome-bridge)） - 需要**屏幕录制**权限（`screencapture` 用） --- ## Field notes [docs/locked-session-and-ax.md](docs/locked-session-and-ax.md) —— 锁屏会让 AX 全废这件事， 以及为什么它看起来跟驱动 bug 一模一样。这个坑花了一整天才确认。 --- ## License MIT。`tools/dsh-cu.swift` 是自包含单文件，想改直接改。 --- ## 关于光标形状 光标是**代码画的**（`cursor/cursor-overlay.swift` 里的 `arrowPath`），圆角经典箭头 + 蓝色渐变，跟浏览器那边用同一条路径 —— 不包含任何第三方素材文件。

plugins.description: DSH Web GUI sidebar glance card: DeepSeek account balance, peak/off-peak billing countdown and today's spend / tokens / calls, seated right above the account row. Self-contained host half; @linxin666/dsh-usage optional.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-account-glance English | [中文](README.zh.md)


The live card: probed balance, Beijing peak / off-peak clock, and today's ledger.

A three-line glance card for the DSH Web GUI, seated **directly above** the sidebar's bottom-left **account / Settings** row: | Line | Content | | --- | --- | | 1 | DeepSeek **account balance** — probed from `/user/balance` with the host-held API key; hover names the source | | 2 | **Peak / off-peak** billing period, with a live countdown to the next flip and the discount in effect | | 3 | **Today's spend / tokens / calls**, plus a **manual refresh** button that forces one fresh probe | Peak / off-peak follows DeepSeek's official schedule (Beijing time, UTC+8 all year): **peak** is Monday–Friday `09:00–12:00` and `14:00–18:00` at full price, **every other hour** (nights and weekends included) is billed at **50% off**. The countdown switches to seconds for the final minute. ## Install Needs **DSH 0.2.0-rc.1 or newer**. No other plugin, no dependencies, no build step. ```bash git clone https://github.com/faith372/dsh-account-glance.git dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:./dsh-account-glance ``` The Plugins page also accepts the repository URL in its **Add plugin** dialog. Installing by hand: put the source at `\plugins\dsh-account-glance\`, add the package to both `dependencies` and `dsh.profile.bundles`, then link it into `node_modules` (or run `pnpm install`). Do **not** add `account-glance` to `cordis.patch.yml` yourself — the package ships that row. **Upgrading from 1.3.x:** the host half is new, so restart DSH (or toggle this row off and on in the Plugins page) and refresh the page once. ## Turning it on and off Sidebar **Plugins** icon → **Installed** → **dsh-account-glance**: the card switch toggles the whole bundle, the row switch toggles this card. Instant — no restart, no refresh — and turning it off brings dsh-usage's own glance card back. ## Where the numbers come from Both data sources live in this plugin's own host half and are served over loopback-only routes (`api/dsh-account-glance/overview`, `.../refresh`); the API key never reaches the browser. - **Balance** — `GET https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance`, with the key resolved from the DSH credential store (pi-ai record → configured env reference → ambient env). No probe value falls back to the `account` Remote (Settings → Account & balance). A route pointed at a reseller is reported as unsupported rather than probed with the official endpoint; a failure keeps the last good number and flags the row. - **Today's usage** — folded from the session event stream into a small per-day ledger at `/account-glance/ledger.json` (atomic write, 180-day retention), keyed by **Beijing date**. - **Cost** is priced for DeepSeek official routes only (the published CNY peak / off-peak table). Other routes — a DashScope-compatible provider, for example — still count tokens and calls, at cost 0, so a mixed ledger never sums two currencies. - `@linxin666/dsh-usage` is **optional**: install it and nothing breaks — this card still reads its own route first, its glance card stays hidden, and its settings and usage pages keep working. Probing is a read-only account query: no prompt, no tokens, no credit. ## Verify ```bash npm test # node test/verify.mjs && node test/host-verify.mjs ``` Both suites run offline. The client suite boots the shipped `lib/client.js` against React / DOM stand-ins: seat and cadence, the probe outranking the account wallet, the fallback identity, the peak clock's boundary cases, the 15-second deadline, the refresh button, the degradation paths, and the dsh-usage fallback. The host suite covers the clock and price book, the ledger, credential resolution and probe shapes, the origin guard, session folding, the route fence, persistence across a restart, and the entry point. ## Known limitations - Hiding dsh-usage's glance card relies on its `data-dsh-plugin="usage"` / `data-dsh-part="foot-card"` attributes; if it renames them, both cards appear (nothing breaks). - The balance belongs to the DeepSeek account the configured key belongs to — swap the key, swap the number. - Cost appears for DeepSeek official routes only; other routes show tokens and calls without an amount. - With dsh-usage installed too, both plugins keep their own ledger (this one buckets days by Beijing date, dsh-usage by host-local date), so the two totals can differ slightly. - The card hides while the sidebar is collapsed to its 56 px rail, matching the shell's own foot area. ## License MIT — except `lib/host/*` and `lib/index.js`, adapted from [`@linxin666/dsh-usage`](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web) v0.4.4 (Apache-2.0). See [`THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md`](THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md) and [`LICENSE-APACHE`](LICENSE-APACHE).

plugins.description: DSH 的持久化共同白板插件：完整白板在左、原生对话在右，人和 AI 持续维护同一份草稿。基于 draft-board。
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH-board

[![CI](https://github.com/MYming-yue/dsh-board/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/MYming-yue/dsh-board/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

**在 DSH 对话旁，放一张人和 AI 可以长期共同维护的白板。**

A persistent shared whiteboard beside the native DeepSeek Harness conversation.

DSH-board 是 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的本地插件，基于 [draft-board](https://github.com/MYming-yue/draft-board)。白板保留理解和成果，对话用来提出问题、讨论与纠正：学一个概念、拆解一个产品，或持续打磨一个项目。

当前为 **0.1.5 早期试用版**。插件单独维护宿主集成，白板界面和模型通过 [upstream.json](upstream.json) 固定上游提交构建，不维护两套白板代码。已构建的安装包可以独立安装，无需相邻的 draft-board 仓库；尚未发布到 npm。

## 可以做什么

- 完整白板在左，DSH 原生对话在右；对话可展开／收起，分隔线可拖动调整宽度。
- 保留 Markdown、LaTeX、图片、卡片备注、关系、集合、布局、结构视图、历史和撤销／重做。
- 新开或切换聊天继续同一张白板，直到主动“新建”或“打开”另一份草稿。
- 选中卡片后发消息，AI 知道本条回复所指的对象；不改写用户回复，不自动附上卡片全文。
- AI 通过 `draft_board_read`／`draft_board_apply` 主动维护白板，复用原子批次、版本校验与整轮撤销。
- 在“设置 → DSH-board 白板”管理启用与卡片关联；关闭功能保留草稿。

## 兼容范围

| 项目 | 已验证范围 |
| --- | --- |
| DSH CLI | 0.1.5-rc.1 |
| DSH 组合包 | 0.1.5-rc.2 |
| 宿主 profile | web |
| 实际宿主联调 | Windows、Chrome |
| 构建环境 | Node.js 22+、npm、Git |

布局和消息提交适配依赖 DSH 当前接口，升级宿主后需要重新验证。其他 DSH 版本和操作系统的完整宿主集成尚未确认；欢迎附版本信息反馈。

## 安装试用版

先确保 DSH web profile 可以正常启动。到 [Releases](https://github.com/MYming-yue/dsh-board/releases) 下载 `dsh-board-0.1.5.tgz`；安装已构建的包不需要 Git、编译工具或 draft-board 源码。

以下为 PowerShell 示例，使用 GitHub CLI 下载。也可以在浏览器下载，再将最后一行改为安装包的绝对路径。

```powershell
$dshHomePath = if ($env:DSH_HOME) { $env:DSH_HOME } else { Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.dsh' }
$pluginDir = Join-Path $dshHomePath 'local-plugins'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $pluginDir | Out-Null
gh release download v0.1.5 --repo MYming-yue/dsh-board --pattern 'dsh-board-0.1.5.tgz' --dir $pluginDir
dsh plugin --profile web add ("file:" + (Join-Path $pluginDir 'dsh-board-0.1.5.tgz'))
```

安装后重启 DSH Web Host，并重新载入页面。在设置中找到“DSH-board 白板”，确认共同白板已启用。

DSH home 使用 `DSH_HOME`，未设置时默认 `~/.dsh`。不要将插件安装到另一个 profile 或 home。更新同样下载新版本安装包后执行 `add` 并重启；构建包使用不同版本和文件名，避免本地依赖缓存误用旧包。

## 第一次体验

1. 在白板上双击创建一张卡片。
2. 选中它，在右侧发送“给这张卡片补充解释”。
3. 观察 AI 工具记录与画布更新，点击“撤销最新一轮”回退该批次。
4. 新开聊天，确认仍然是当前白板。

AI 使用 DSH 原有模型、工具和审批流程。插件不增加模型 API 配置，不管理账户，也不添加云同步。

## 保存、上下文与管理

草稿位于 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-board/`，包含图片与历史；`current.json` 指向当前草稿。主动更换时保留前一份宿主文件。原生“打开”“保存”“另存为”继续可用：宿主持有一份副本，绑定的磁盘原文件仍通过白板保存入口回写，页面刷新后需重新绑定其文件句柄。

固定使用说明注册在系统提示末尾；卡片身份和短标题在本轮运行上下文末尾注入。相同关联复用原生快照，不为每条回复重复追加。不附上全文、时间戳或修订号，不重写既有历史；发生过变化的快照仍由宿主保留，缓存命中率取决于宿主和模型服务。

“设置 → DSH-board 白板”提供“启用共同白板”和“发送时关联选中的卡片”。关闭白板恢复完整聊天区、暂停白板工具，保留草稿与未提交输入；重新启用后继续维护。选项和待处理关联保存在 `plugin-state.json`。

浏览器约每 750ms 与宿主同步。输入、指针操作、布局和回放期间保留当前操作。并行修改冲突时保留双方内容、暂停镜像；另存为后重新打开副本，明确选择继续维护的版本。当前没有自动合并、多任务白板管理、多人协作、AI 图片解析或完整消息／批次追溯。

卸载插件：

```text
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-board
```

随后重启宿主；卸载不会删除 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-board/` 中的草稿。

## 从源码构建

```bash
git clone https://github.com/MYming-yue/dsh-board.git
cd dsh-board
npm ci
node node_modules/playwright-core/cli.js install chromium
npm run check
```

首次构建自动拉取锁定的 draft-board 提交并执行其锁定依赖安装，需要访问 GitHub 与 npm。源码缓存在被忽略的 `.upstream/`；构建产物位于 `lib/`。上游锁不变时复用缓存；更新需显式修改 `upstream.json` 并重新验证。构建不会读取个人 DSH 配置、模型凭据或草稿。

`npm run check` 执行上游类型检查、界面与模型构建、插件测试，以及真实浏览器的安装包检查。安装包检查从 tgz 解压运行，验证持久化、画布接收批次与整轮撤销，不调用模型 API。`DSH_BOARD_BROWSER=chromium` 可指定 Playwright Chromium；默认依次尝试系统 Chrome、Edge、Chromium。Linux 可用 `install --with-deps chromium`。

发布包：

```bash
npm run build
npm pack --pack-destination artifacts
```

贡献前阅读 [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) 和 [规格](docs/spec.md)。涉及宿主接口的变化仍需在实际 DSH 中联调，不能只用合成宿主检查宣称兼容。

## 来源与许可

本项目采用 [MIT License](LICENSE)。插件最初位于 draft-board 的 `plugins/dsh-board/`，从提交 `c37c6fe` 拆出。

白板界面和纯模型来自锁定的 draft-board，安装包保留其许可证及来源。构建会收集所嵌入运行依赖的许可证，写入 `lib/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt`；包含 React、KaTeX、markdown-it、fflate、nanoid 等依赖的声明。DSH 本体由使用者单独安装，本插件不打包分发 DSH 源码。

plugins.description: DSH plugin: control iKuai (爱快) soft routers over their JSON API. Zero-dependency Node MCP stdio server exposing 11 read tools plus a write-gated generic API call; credentials live in the DSH credential store.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-ikuai-mcp

在 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 里控制爱快 (iKuai) 软路由。纯 Node 零依赖的 MCP stdio server + DSH 宿主半：
模型侧出现 11 个 `mcp__ikuai__*` 工具，另有 3 个宿主工具（`ikuai_credentials_status` /
`ikuai_set_credentials` / `ikuai_ping`）。写操作默认关闭。

- 只读：系统状态、LAN/WAN 接口、在线终端、DHCP 地址池与绑定、DNS、静态路由、VLAN、DDNS、端口映射
- 通用读写 `ikuai_api_call`：需 `IKUAI_ALLOW_WRITES=1`，且每次调用传 `confirm: true`
- 连接参数存 DSH 凭据中心，改密码/换 IP 不用重启 DSH
- 默认 `https://192.168.1.1`（爱快出厂 LAN 地址），用户名 `admin`

---

## 安装

> 用法：把这个仓库地址（或本地目录）发给你 DSH 里的 AI，说一句「按 README 的安装一节把 dsh-ikuai-mcp 装好」。

### 交给 DSH 里的 AI（照做即可）

1. **安装进 profile**（三选一，把占位符换成实际值）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add /绝对路径/dsh-ikuai-mcp       # 本地目录（必须是绝对路径）
dsh plugin --profile web add github:MingShi350/dsh-ikuai-mcp  # GitHub
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-ikuai-mcp                 # npm
```

2. **确认写进了 profile**（`bundles` 里应出现 `dsh-ikuai-mcp`）：

```bash
node -e 'const p=require(process.env.HOME+"/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json");console.log(p.dsh.profile.bundles.filter(b=>b.includes("ikuai")))'
```

3. **重启 dsh web**。这一步交给用户做，agent 不要 `kill` 宿主进程（会中断当前会话）。
   装了 dshmarket 的话，界面上的「待重启」提示旁有一键重启。

4. **配置连接参数**（见下一节）。**不要猜 IP 和密码，问用户要。**

5. **验证**：调用 `ikuai_credentials_status`，再调用 `ikuai_ping`。

### 判断装好没有

| 现象 | 含义 | 处理 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 工具列表里出现 11 个 `mcp__ikuai__*` | 装好了 | 去配置连接参数 |
| 只有 `ikuai_credentials_status` / `ikuai_set_credentials` / `ikuai_ping` | 宿主半起来了，MCP 那一行没起 | 看 `mcp-server:ikuai` 开关是否被关；确认第 2 步的 `bundles` 里有它；确认重启过 |
| 一个都没有 | 插件没装上 | 回到第 1 步 |

### 原理（手工安装时才需要看）

`package.json` 的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 指向 `cordis.patch.yml`，里面的 `- insert:` 两行分别是宿主半和
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`（以 stdio 挂载 `server/ikuai-mcp-server.mjs`）。`dsh plugin add` 会自动把包名
追加进 `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/dsh.profile.bundles`，启动时装配；不想装包也可以手工把那两行并进
profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`。

---

## 配置：改爱快 IP / 加账号密码

取值优先级：**环境变量 > DSH 凭据中心 > 默认值**。默认值：

| 键 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `IKUAI_URL` | `https://192.168.1.1` | 爱快 web 管理地址；只写 `192.168.1.1` 会自动补 `https://` |
| `IKUAI_USERNAME` | `admin` | web 登录用户名 |
| `IKUAI_PASSWORD` | 空 | 必须配，否则工具直接报「未配置 IKUAI_PASSWORD」 |

### 改 IP

先用浏览器确认管理地址能打开：默认 `192.168.1.1`；改过 LAN 网段就用改后的地址；端口不是 80/443 要带上，
例如 `http://192.168.1.1:81`。然后任选一种：

**A. 让 agent 调工具写进凭据中心（不用重启）**

```
ikuai_set_credentials  { "url": "192.168.1.1", "username": "admin", "password": "你的web登录密码" }
```

会先归一化地址 → 再用这组参数试连一次 → 成功才写入。连不上就不落盘（确需强存加 `"allowUnverified": true`）。
写入后 **5 秒内生效**。

**B. 在 GUI 里填（推荐，密码不进对话记录）**

设置 → 凭据中心 → 新增 `IKUAI_URL`（值如 `192.168.1.1`），同样方式加 `IKUAI_USERNAME`、`IKUAI_PASSWORD`。

**C. 环境变量**

给启动 DSH 的进程设 `IKUAI_URL=http://192.168.1.1`，需重启。注意环境变量**优先于**凭据中心，
设了之后在凭据中心改同名值不生效。

### 加账号密码

密码就是你登录爱快 web 管理页的那个密码。

- **推荐**：设置 → 凭据中心 → 加 `IKUAI_PASSWORD`（明文只存 `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`，权限 0600，不进对话记录）
- 或者调 `ikuai_set_credentials { "password": "..." }` —— 该参数是明文，**会留在会话记录里**，能用 GUI 就用 GUI

### 验证

```text
ikuai_credentials_status   →  四项生效值与来源（env / 凭据中心 / 默认值）
ikuai_ping                 →  ✅ 登录成功：192.168.1.1（用户 admin）
mcp__ikuai__ikuai_status   →  CPU / 内存 / 在线终端数
```

`ikuai_ping` 结果对照：

| 返回 | 含义 |
| --- | --- |
| `✅ 登录成功：…` | 通了 |
| `❌ 登录失败：code=1005 账号或密码错误` | 用户名/密码不对 |
| `❌ 连接失败：connect ECONNREFUSED …` | 地址或端口不对 |
| `❌ …响应不是 JSON（地址可能不是爱快 web 管理端口）` | 这个端口不是爱快管理页 |

### 什么时候要重启

| 改的是 | 重启？ |
| --- | --- |
| 凭据中心里的 `IKUAI_*` | 不用（每次调用重读，5s 缓存） |
| `server/*.mjs` 代码 | 重挂 MCP 子进程：能力面板把 `mcp-server:ikuai` 关掉再打开，或 kill `server/ikuai-mcp-server.mjs`（配了 reconnect 会自动拉起） |
| `lib/index.mjs` 或 `cordis.patch.yml` | 重启 dsh web |

---

## 写权限（默认只读）

任何非 `show/get/list/query/search` 的调用默认被拒。开启方式二选一，都不用重启：

1. **推荐**：设置 → 凭据中心 添加 `IKUAI_ALLOW_WRITES = 1`（5s 生效；改回 `0` 立刻恢复只读）
2. 给 DSH 进程设 `IKUAI_ALLOW_WRITES=1`（需重启）

开启后每次写仍要传 `"confirm": true`；插件不提供「让模型自己开写权限」的工具。写之前先 `show` 拿原记录
（含 `id`/`uuid`），改字段后 `edit` 回写。排序参数必须大写（`ORDER_BY` + `ORDER`），小写会被静默忽略。

---

## 工具清单

| 工具 | `func_name` | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ikuai_status` | `homepage` | CPU/内存/温度/在线终端数/连接数/运行时长/WAN 线路 |
| `ikuai_interfaces` | `lan` | 物理端口、上下线、netinfo（内外网 IP/网关）、VLAN 失败项 |
| `ikuai_online_devices` | `monitor_lanip` | 在线终端：IP/MAC/名称/流量/连接数；分页 + `order_by`/`order` |
| `ikuai_dhcp_pools` | `dhcp_server` | 各 LAN/VLAN 地址池、租期、网关、DNS |
| `ikuai_dhcp_bindings` | `dhcp_static` | 静态绑定 + 动态租约混合列表（`static_status`: 1=静态） |
| `ikuai_dns_config` | `dns` | 本机 DNS 开关、上游 DNS、代理规则、缓存 |
| `ikuai_static_routes` | `static_rt` + `static_rt_table` | 用户静态路由规则 + 生效路由表 |
| `ikuai_vlan_config` | `vlan` | VLAN ID/名称/成员端口/tag |
| `ikuai_ddns_config` | `ddns` | DDNS 配置与最近解析 IP（密码/AK 已脱敏） |
| `ikuai_port_mapping` | `dnat` + `netmap` + `upnpd_leases` | 端口映射、1:1 映射、UPnP 租约 |
| `ikuai_api_call` | 任意 | 通用读写兜底（ACL/QoS/流控/域名黑名单/syslog 等） |

**V3 → V4 模块名**：V4 改了名，用旧名会 `code=1003 Access denied` ——
`dhcp_addr_bind`→`dhcp_static`、`port_mapping`→`dnat`、`upnp`→`upnpd`、`static_routing`→`static_rt`、
`mac_bind`→`acl_mac`/`mac_comment`。插件会自动回退候选名。
注意 V4 对不存在的模块也回同样的 `1003`，无法与「无权限」区分。

---

## 安全

- 爱快用自签证书，客户端必须放开证书校验；**只在受信内网用**，不要指向公网设备。
- 密码明文存 `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`（0600）。插件不把凭据写进 `process.env`。
- 结果按字段名**尽力**脱敏：`pass|pwd|secret|token|credential|api_key|access_key`、以 `key` 结尾的字段，
  以及 `LTAI…`/`AKIA…` 形式的云 AccessKeyId；不认识的字段名原样返回，别当脱敏网关用。
- 写操作能改坏网络（DHCP、路由、端口映射），所以默认只读 + 每次 `confirm`。

---

## 自测

离线，不需要路由器也不需要凭据：

```bash
npm test
node tests/mock-test.mjs   # 握手、11 工具、会话过期重登、写请求不重放、写闸门、脱敏、坏地址不崩
node tests/host-test.mjs   # 宿主半：env 不被污染、来源标注、set_credentials 校验与先试连后落盘
```

---

## 排错

| 现象 | 处理 |
| --- | --- |
| 看不到 `mcp__ikuai__*` | 能力面板 `mcp-server:ikuai` 是否被关；`bundles` 里有没有它；是否重启过 |
| 报「未配置 IKUAI_PASSWORD」 | 凭据中心里加 `IKUAI_PASSWORD` |
| 报 `code=1005` | 用户名/密码不对；若该值来自环境变量，改完要重启 |
| 报 `ECONNREFUSED` / 超时 | 地址或端口不对，先确认浏览器能打开该地址 |
| 改配置没生效 | 凭据中心的值 5s 内生效；若存在同名环境变量，它会盖住凭据中心 |
| 写操作被拒 | 默认只读，见「写权限」；并确认传了 `confirm: true` |

---

## 已知限制

- 写操作只有通用透传，没有为 DHCP/DNS/路由写专用写工具（字段名随固件变化）。
- 未覆盖 Docker / QEMU / 行为审计 / AC 管理 / SD-WAN，用 `ikuai_api_call` 直接调 `func_name`。
- 会话 10 分钟重登一次；爱快并发登录会互相顶号，别同时开着 web UI 做写操作。
- 部分字段是设备回吐的原始字节（如 DHCP 租约的 `hostname`），按 UTF-8 解可能是乱码。
- 大结果不裁剪：`ikuai_online_devices` 默认 100 行 × 约 50 字段，按需调小 `limit`。
- 仅在 iKuai V4 (4.0.311 x64) 上完整实测；V3 走候选名回退，未逐项验证。

---

## 许可与致谢

MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。作者：[MingShi350](https://github.com/MingShi350)。

API 用法与 `func_name` 清单参考 [beck-8/ikuai-mcp](https://github.com/beck-8/ikuai-mcp)（MIT，© 2026 Beck），
本项目是独立的 Node 实现，详见 [THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md](THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md)。

plugins.description: 面向 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）的专家与专家团插件：给 AI 加"角色与团队"两个协作维度——用一个领域专家的身份干活，或拉起一支多 Agent 团队按流程交付。
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH 专家工坊 · dsh-expert-suite

面向 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）的**专家**与**专家团**插件：给 AI 加"角色与团队"两个协作维度——用一个领域专家的身份干活，或拉起一支多 Agent 团队按流程交付。 - **专家（Expert）**：单角色切换——「人设 + 方法论 + 工具白名单」，让 AI 以特定领域专家身份执行任务，且白名单是进程内强约束； - **专家团（Expert Team）**：多 Agent 协作——团长把任务拆解、按需派工给成员子代理、整合交付，支持会话式（和团长对话）与批量（一次跑完）两种工作方式； - **三种创建方式**：手动创建（工具 / 面板表单）、文件导入（JSON / Markdown）、AI 生成（一句话描述 → 自动成稿入库）。 随包内置 8 位专家与 1 个「全栈交付团」，开箱即用。 ## 特性 - 🧑‍💻 **召唤专家**：注入 persona + 工具白名单门禁，`/expert data_analyst` 即用； - 👥 **会话式专家团**：进入团队和团长对话，打招呼就只是打招呼，有任务才按需派工； - ⚙️ **批量交付**：`team_run` 一次跑完整条流水线（serial / parallel / auto 三种执行模式 + step 干预）； - 📥 **多种创建方式**：手动表单 / 文件导入（JSON、Markdown）/ AI 生成，均校验后入库； - 🔒 **进程内权限隔离**：工具白名单由宿主 `tools.guard()` 单调拒绝，不是提示词提醒； - 🎛️ **图形面板**：设置页分栏 + 悬浮入口，浏览 / 创建 / 导入 / 详情 / 一键召唤与进入； - 🧩 **运行时 skill**：每位专家 / 每个团队 / 使用说明都注册为 skill，AI 可随时加载； - 🔌 **零侵入降级**：所有宿主接缝集中在适配层，服务缺席只降级、不影响宿主。 ## 安装 **从 npm 安装（推荐）**：在 DSH 的「插件」页（设置 / 侧边栏）搜索安装 `dsh-expert-suite`；或用命令行： ```sh dsh plugin add dsh-expert-suite ``` 装完**重启一次**：插件加载时会把「专家模式」「专家团模式」两个预设铺到 `$DSH_HOME/.agent-presets/`，重启后出现在预设选择器里。 **从源码开发安装**：构建产物后引入（见下文「开发」）。 > 兼容性：对齐 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` 运行时与 `@deepseek-ai/*` rc peer；更早版本请按宿主安装时的 peer 提示处理（`dsh plugin --profile allow-version` 授权）。 ## 快速上手 ```text # 单专家 /expert-list # 浏览名册 /expert data_analyst # 召唤数据分析师（注入 persona + 工具白名单） /expert data_analyst 帮我解读这份报表 # 召唤 + 立即发送第一句话 /expert-dismiss # 退出专家模式 # 专家团（会话式：进入团队，和团长对话） /team-list # 浏览团队 /team fullstack_delivery # 进入团队（打招呼、问能力、下任务都行） /team fullstack_delivery 你好 # 进入团队并发送第一句话 # 之后正常对话：团长确认任务后才按需派工，打招呼就只是打招呼 # AI 创建（在会话里直接说） 请调用 expert_generate：我需要一个专门写技术文档的专家 请调用 team_generate：帮我组建一个能完成产品从设计到上线的团队 ``` 也可以全程用工具驱动：`expert_list` → `expert_summon` → `expert_dismiss`；团队侧 `team_dispatch`（团长按需派工）/ `team_status` / `team_end`，或 `team_run`（批量一次跑完）。 图形界面：**设置 →「DSH 专家工坊」**（或右下角悬浮按钮）打开浏览面板，可视化浏览 / 创建 / 导入专家与专家团。 ## 核心概念 ### 专家（Expert） 一个专家 = 一份「人设 + 方法论（persona）」+ 一个工具白名单（`toolFilter`）。召唤后，模型以该专家身份执行任务；白名单外的工具调用被当场拒绝（进程内强约束）。字段： `id / name / category / description / capabilities / expertise[] / exampleTasks[] / persona / model? / toolFilter[] / source` ### 专家团（Expert Team） 一个团队 = 团长（lead）+ 若干成员（members），成员按 `order` 排序、各带 `responsibility`。字段： `id / name / description / executionMode(serial|parallel|auto) / interventionMode(auto|step) / members[{expertId, order, responsibility}] / leadPersona? / source` ### 三种创建方式 | 方式 | 入口 | 说明 | | --- | --- | --- | | 手动创建 | 面板「创建专家 / 创建专家团」、工具 `expert_create` / `team_create` | 逐字段填写；团队成员可选现有专家或「自定义角色」现场定义 | | 文件导入 | 面板「导入」、工具 `expert_import` / `team_import` | 专家支持 JSON / Markdown；团队只支持 JSON | | AI 生成 | 面板「AI 生成」、工具 `expert_generate` / `team_generate` | 自然语言描述 → 生成器子代理成稿 → 校验后入库 | ## 使用指南 ### 召唤与退出专家 - 召唤：`/expert `，或面板点「召唤专家」；可带一句话 `/expert 消息` 立即开工。 - 退出：`/expert-dismiss`，或状态条上的 ✕。 - 召唤成功后面板自动收起，右上角状态条显示当前专家 / 团队，可一键退出。 ### 团队协作：会话式（默认）与批量（显式） **会话式（默认）**——`/team <团队id>` 或面板「进入专家团」：注入团长契约，你和团长对话。打招呼、问团队能力就只是对话；有实际任务时团长先澄清目标、再用 `team_dispatch` 按需派工给成员（每次派工 = 一次 one-shot 子代理，等待交付后整合回复你），**不会一上来跑全队**。随时 `team_status` 看派工记录，`team_end` 结束并把各成员交付留档供总结。 **批量（显式）**——`team_run` 工具：给定自包含总目标，团长一次拆解、按执行模式跑完所有相关成员并整合总结。适合"现在就把整件事跑完"。 批量模式的执行模式（团队定义里的 `executionMode`）： - `serial`：按 `order` 串行，后续成员能看到前序交付物； - `parallel`：全部成员同一波次并行（受 `maxParallelMembers` 限制，默认 4），团长最后整合； - `auto`：团长先做结构化规划（`outputSchema` 校验的波次计划），按波次执行；规划失败自动回退为按 `order` 串行并记入日志； - `interventionMode: step`：每位成员（或每个并行波次）交付后暂停，用 `team_message(action=continue)` 放行。 成员的「连续性」由提示词承载（后续派工带上前序交付物全文），子代理会话不做跨派工驻留——这是 v1 的刻意取舍，换取只依赖宿主最稳定的 API 面。 ### 权限与工具白名单 - **专家召唤**：`toolFilter` 通过宿主 `tools.guard()`（单调拒绝，不可撤销）按 agent 生效；白名单外的工具调用被当场拒绝并说明原因。空白名单 = 不限制。 - **团队成员**：每次派工都是一次 one-shot 子代理（`ctx.subagents.start('spawn')`），其 `persona` / `toolFilter` / `maxDepth=1` 在子代理创建窗口内落地，且不能继续向下委派。 - **团长**：默认 `leadToolFace: 'coordinator'`——只协调不执行（拒绝 `bash`/`pwsh`/`write`/`edit`）；可在 Config 改为 `full`。 - **指定模型**：专家定义里的 `model` 映射到子代理 `agentOptions.model`，需要宿主开启「子代理模型选择」opt-in，否则派工会报错——内置专家默认不指定模型（继承会话路由）。 - **跨平台工具名**：`toolFilter` 里的工具名会按当前部署可见工具自动清洗（例如 Windows 上没有 `bash`、提供 `pwsh`），避免未知名导致 spawn 失败。 ## 工具清单（19 个） | 工具 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | `expert_list` / `expert_get` | 列出（支持 `category` 筛选）/ 获取专家完整定义 | | `expert_create` / `expert_import` / `expert_delete` | 创建（zod 校验）/ 导入 / 删除（内置不可删） | | `expert_summon` / `expert_dismiss` | 召唤（注入 persona + 启用门禁）/ 退出 | | `team_list` / `team_get` / `team_create` / `team_import` / `team_delete` | 团队同名管理操作 | | `team_dispatch` | （团长模式）按需派工一项子任务给成员，等待交付并返回 | | `team_run` | 批量模式：`teamId` + 自包含 `objective` 一次跑完全队并整合，返回 `runId` | | `team_status` | 查看运行状态（成员进度、日志、总结）；缺省返回当前会话的活跃团队 | | `team_message` | `action=send` 与成员对话；`action=continue` 放行 step 模式暂停点 | | `team_end` | 结束团队（缺省结束当前会话的活跃团队），返回各成员交付供总结 | | `expert_generate` / `team_generate` | 自然语言 → AI 生成专家 / 从现有名册组团并入库（`save=false` 可只预览） | ## 数据与存储 ``` $DSH_HOME/expert-suite/ ├── experts/.json 用户创建 / 导入 / AI 生成的专家 └── teams/.json 用户创建 / 导入 / AI 生成的专家团 ``` 内置资产随包提供；**同 id 时用户目录版本优先**。内置定义不可删除（返回 `BUILTIN_READONLY`）。 ## 导入格式 ### 专家 **JSON**：直接是完整定义对象；**Markdown**：YAML frontmatter + 正文（正文即 persona）： ```markdown --- id: tech_doc_writer name: 技术文档专家 category: 写作 description: 面向开发者的技术文档写作 expertise: [技术写作, Vue, Vite] exampleTasks: - 把这份源码注释整理成教程 toolFilter: [read, write, grep, glob] capabilities: |- 多行能力介绍…… --- 你是资深技术文档工程师……（persona 正文） ``` ### 专家团 只支持 **JSON**。成员通过 `expertId` 引用**已存在的专家**，所以先确保这些专家在名册里： ```json { "id": "launch_team", "name": "上线筹备组", "description": "把新产品从定义推到上线", "executionMode": "auto", "interventionMode": "auto", "members": [ { "expertId": "product_manager", "order": 0, "responsibility": "产出需求定义与验收标准，交给设计师" }, { "expertId": "ui_designer", "order": 1, "responsibility": "基于需求产出界面方案" }, { "expertId": "code_reviewer", "order": 2, "responsibility": "评审可实现性与风险" } ], "leadPersona": "可选：自定义团长人设，留空用内置模板" } ``` - `executionMode`：`auto`（推荐）/ `serial` / `parallel`； - `interventionMode`：`auto` 全自动 / `step` 每位成员交付后暂停等你放行； - `members[].order`：数字，决定默认执行顺序；`members[].responsibility`：该成员负责什么、产出交给谁； - 名册里没有的角色，可在「创建专家团」表单用「+ 自定义角色」现场建，或先创建 / 导入专家；导入后自动注册运行时 skill，同 id 覆盖已有版本。 ## 插件配置 在 `cordis.yml` 的插件行里配置： ```yaml - insert: - id: expert-suite name: 'dsh-expert-suite' config: dataDir: '' # 缺省 $DSH_HOME/expert-suite layPresets: true # 自动铺设两个预设 maxParallelMembers: 4 # 波次内最大并行子代理数 leadToolFace: 'coordinator' # coordinator | full ``` ## 架构与平台集成 宿主半边按官方契约实现：`ctx.tools.register` / `ctx.tools.guard`、`ctx.subagents.start('spawn', …)`、`ctx.skills.register`（运行时 skill）、`ctx.commands.register`、`ctx.webServer.register`（0.2.0 起为 `webServer`，0.1.5 线为 `httpServer`，两个名字都挂 inject 回调、谁先就绪注册谁）、`agent.inject` / `agent.followup`、`ctx.agents.get` / `list`。所有宿主接缝集中在 `src/ports.ts`（host）与 `src/client/slots.ts`（client），改宿主版本适配只动这两处。 Client 半边按官方模块加载契约实现（`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` 自注册、`require('react')` 取平台 React、导出 `{ apply, inject }`），面板是 Vue 3 SFC 通过 React 宿主组件以「孤岛」挂载。入口为两个已核实的官方 slot：`settings.section`（设置页分栏）与 `shell.overlay`（右下角悬浮按钮）。面板数据与动作走 `/expert-suite/*` 路由（在 webserver 上注册；无 webserver 的 profile 自动降级为只读空态）。 两个值得知道的平台行为： - **链接安装的包**（`link:` / `file:`）内部 import 的 `@deepseek-ai/*` peer 会被宿主重定向到安装副本——本包 `peerDependencies` 必须与运行时真实 import 一一对应； - **插件展示元数据**：`locale/{en,zh}.json` 的 `meta.title/description` + `package.json` 的 `icon`（宿主 `readPluginMeta` 经 ESM 解析读取，`exports` 必须放出 `./locale/*.json`）。 ## 开发 ```sh pnpm install pnpm run typecheck # TypeScript 严格模式（零错误为合并门禁） pnpm run build # host（tsc → dist/）+ client（vite → dist/client.js） pnpm publish # 发布前会先跑 build ``` 本地装进 DSH 调试：把本包以 `link:` / `file:` 引入 profile，或 `

plugins.description: DSH plugin: memory-preserving session handoff. Carries a conversation into a fresh session before it becomes unusable, and rescues sessions that already are.
plugins.readme_text:
[![dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh--plugin-yes-4b6bfb)](https://github.com/iuuuuuuuu/dsh-session-handoff)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-2ea44f)](./LICENSE)
[![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22.15-339933)](https://nodejs.org)

# dsh-session-handoff

**English** · [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md)

Carry a conversation's memory into a new session **before** the old one becomes unusable.

## The problem this solves

A long DSH session eventually reaches a size where its own compaction stops working. The
mechanism is worth stating precisely, because it is what makes the failure permanent:

- Compaction replays the **whole shadowed region** as the input to one summarization request.
- The upstream provider enforces a hard ceiling on one request's prompt.
- Once the session passes that ceiling, the compaction request *is itself* over the ceiling.
- So compaction fails with the same overflow it was supposed to cure, every time, forever.

The session then cannot be compacted, cannot be continued, and — because the naive handoff
implementations build their summarization request the same way — cannot be handed off either.
That is the deadlock. `/handoff` exists to break it.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add /path/to/dsh-session-handoff
```

If your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` already mounts this plugin by hand, remove that row
first, or you will run two instances.

**Restart DSH.** This is required, not optional: the harness keeps loaded plugin modules in
its loader cache, and `hmr.root` defaults to `[]`, so editing a plugin's source does **not**
take effect in a running host.

After restarting, the log shows:

```
[session-handoff] installed: /handoff registered, pressure monitor active (upstream limit 1048576)
```

## Use

```
/handoff           hand this conversation off to a fresh session
/handoff-status    show the measurement, the binding ceiling, and the trigger state
```

`/handoff` prints a report:

```
Handed off `session-9ef22e43-…` to `session-e7d70ba3-…`.

- read: 32286 messages, 117541 events
- memory: 240 facts, 0 checkpoints
- summarize: 70 chunk(s), source=map-reduce, 18422 chars
- seed: 21544 chars (~5386 tokens)
- create: session-e7d70ba3-…
- archive: session-9ef22e43-…

The source session is archived; it stays readable in the sidebar.
```

The source is archived **last**, so a failure anywhere earlier leaves it intact and usable.

## What it does

### It watches

At every **turn boundary** the plugin measures the session's token pressure and classifies it
against **two** independent ceilings, binding on whichever is tighter:

| Ceiling | Where it comes from | Why it matters |
| --- | --- | --- |
| The model's context window | read from the model configuration the session is using | what the model itself accepts |
| The upstream prompt limit | configured, because nothing declares it | what the provider accepts on **one request** |

The second is the one that actually kills sessions, and it is *not* derivable from the first —
a routed model may advertise a 1,000,000-token window while the account behind it enforces
less on a single request.

When pressure crosses the policy ladder the plugin injects a **notice** into the session
naming the measured number, the binding ceiling, and the way out. A notice is model-facing
context for the next step, so it **never starts a turn on its own**, and it is rate-limited on
both growth and time so a session parked at `critical` does not nag.

### It hands off

`/handoff` runs one transaction:

```
1. read        the live session (messages + events)
2. memory      extract four layers of memory
3. summarize   bounded map-reduce, one request per chunk
4. create      the successor, inheriting the source's route and cwd
5. deliver     the seed as the successor's opening turn
6. archive     the source, with stopActivity — its work is terminated
7. release     drop the source's live event tree
```

**The successor starts working immediately.** The seed is not a note for you to read; it is
delivered as the successor's first turn, so the new session picks the work up and continues.

### Archiving does not free memory, and releasing only half-frees it

Archiving is a **visibility** change: the session id joins the archive set, which hides it
from the sidebar's default view. Its log stays on disk, it stays readable, and unarchiving
restores its exact position. **Nothing is deleted, and nothing is freed.**

**One rule governs memory: a session is released only once it is archived.** A handoff that
keeps the source visible — the automatic default — leaves it resident, because you may still
be looking at it. Anything you archive yourself is picked up by a periodic sweep of the
archive set, since a manual archive emits no event a plugin can listen for.

Releasing calls `SessionStore.remove(id)`, which runs the store's official detach lifecycle.

**What that does and does not free.** A session is held by two independent registries:

| Registry | What it holds | Can a plugin drop it? |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ctx.sessions` | the session's event tree | **yes** — `sessions.remove(id)` |
| `ctx.agents` | the agent, which holds the session | **no** |

The agent registry is a plain `Map` with **no public removal**: `agents.enter()` returns the
detach disposer, but `enter()` is called by the agent loop, not by a plugin, and neither
`agents.remove` nor `agent.dispose` exists on the public surface. So releasing a session
removes it from the session store while its agent keeps the tree reachable. The log on disk is
untouched either way.

Measured, with a real `SessionStore` and a real `AgentRegistry`:

```
BEFORE release:  sessions.get(id) -> true    agents.get(id) -> true
AFTER  release:  sessions.get(id) -> false   agents.get(id) -> true
                 the agent still carries all events
```

A session whose own agent is still **running** is skipped, because removing it then would race
its closing events. Switch the sweep off with `monitor.releaseArchived: false`.

### The memory it carries

The design question is *what to carry*. Four layers, ordered by cost:

| Layer | Source | Fidelity | Cost |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Verbatim facts** | Regex extraction over the transcript | Exact | Free |
| **Earlier checkpoints** | Successful `compaction/end` summaries the session already wrote | Exact | Free |
| **Recent turns, verbatim** | The tail of the conversation, word for word | Exact | Free |
| **Narrative summary** | Model-written, map-reduce | Paraphrase | One pass |

The three exact layers are never dropped to make room for the paraphrase: only the narrative
layer is truncated, and only from its middle. The verbatim tail gets a *reserved share* of the
seed budget rather than competing with prose for the leftovers, because facts give you the
paths while only the tail gives you the exact thought you were mid-way through.

### Credentials never ride along

The verbatim layer is a *copy*, so anything the session once echoed — a token printed while
debugging, a key in a dotenv dump — would be copied too. A handoff seed is a new artifact that
may be read or shared, so it is redacted by shape before it is written: bearer tokens, `sk-` /
`ghp_` / `github_pat_` / `xox` / `AKIA` keys, JWTs, PEM private keys, `password=`-style
assignments and inline connection-string passwords. The fact layer is redacted too, since a
path can embed a secret.

## Automatic handoff

Automatic handoff is **on by default**; automatic archiving is **off**.

The distinction is the point: handing off creates a successor that keeps working, while
archiving *hides* the session that broke. When a session dies while you are away, that session
is evidence — you want to see what it was doing, not find it gone.

Three independent triggers, because a session can become unusable in three different ways:

| Trigger | Signal | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Pressure** | measured pressure reaches `atLevel` | `critical` |
| **Failed turns** | a run of consecutive failed turns | 2 |
| **Compaction failure** | a failure streak **and** enough volume | 3 failures, 35% of the window |

Only `error`

plugins.description: DSH plugin: enforce AI rules and protect tools/paths from accidental modification.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-bulwark

DSH 插件：向 systemPrompt 注入守则段，并在工具调用层拦截受保护路径的修改与受保护插件的卸载。

## 功能

- **守则注入**：把一个可配置的守则段写进 systemPrompt，位置由中心顺序表推导。
- **路径保护**：拦截对 protectedPaths 内路径的写 / 删 / 移动（含相对路径与 cd 链解析、重定向、dd / truncate / tee、python / node 内联脚本）。
- **插件卸载保护**：命中 protectedRemovalPatterns 关键词的卸载 / 删除命令一律拦截。
- **配置热重载**：监听 config.json，改动后无需重启。
- **逃生通道**：一个环境变量即可完全禁用。

## 安装

```
dsh plugin add github:Hashing2030/dsh-bulwark
```

安装后重启 DSH 生效。

> **首次启动会看到一行提示**：
> `[dsh-bulwark:config] watcher unavailable, config changes need a restart: ENOENT...`
> 这不是错误。它表示 config.json 还没创建，热重载暂未启用。创建配置文件后此提示自动消失。

## 配置

配置文件路径：`$DSH_HOME/dsh-bulwark/config.json`（`DSH_HOME` 未设置时退回 `~/.dsh`）。

完整默认值：

```json
{
  "rulesText": "[dsh-bulwark 守则] 部分工具和路径受保护，不要尝试绕过。",
  "protectedPaths": [],
  "protectedRemovalPatterns": [
    { "keywords": ["dsh plugin", "remove", "dsh-bulwark"] },
    { "keywords": ["dsh plugin", "remove", "dsh-plugin-host-template"] },
    { "keywords": ["dsh plugin", "remove", "dsh-plugin-client-template"] },
    { "keywords": ["pnpm", "remove", "dsh-bulwark"] },
    { "keywords": ["npm", "uninstall", "dsh-bulwark"] }
  ]
}
```

字段说明见 [CONFIG.md](CONFIG.md)。

## 用 CLI 管理配置（推荐）

不建议手改 JSON。用 scripts/protect.sh：

```
# 从插件安装目录进入（路径按实际 profile 替换）
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-bulwark

./scripts/protect.sh add /path/to/protect
./scripts/protect.sh list
./scripts/protect.sh remove /path/to/protect
./scripts/protect.sh test "rm -rf /path/to/protect/foo"
./scripts/protect.sh set-rules "[dsh-bulwark 守则] 新的守则内容"
```

也可以克隆一份仓库，用仓库里的脚本操作同一个配置文件：

```
git clone https://github.com/Hashing2030/dsh-bulwark
cd dsh-bulwark
./scripts/protect.sh add /path/to/protect
```

完整命令说明见 [SCRIPT-USAGE.md](SCRIPT-USAGE.md)。

## 逃生通道

```
DSH_FORTRESS_DISABLE=1 dsh web
```

设置这个环境变量后，DSH 启动时完全不加载 dsh-bulwark。清除即恢复。

> 变量名 DSH_FORTRESS_DISABLE 中的 FORTRESS 是项目旧名（dsh-fortress）的遗留。改名时保留它是为了不破坏已有配置。

## 本地开发

```
pnpm install
pnpm build          # tsdown → dist/index.js
dsh web --patch cordis.yml    # 用源码路径加载，不用装
```

## 测试

```
pnpm test:e2e       # 71 条端到端回归
```

## 相关文档

- [配置说明](CONFIG.md)
- [脚本用法](SCRIPT-USAGE.md)
- [灾难恢复](DISASTER-RECOVERY.md)
- [测试说明](TESTING.md)
- [迁移记录](MIGRATION.md)

## 许可证
